design_positioning.product_personality: quiet, capable and specific to the product job
design_positioning.audience_context: operators and product users who need to scan state, evidence and next action quickly
design_positioning.trust_posture: state, consequence and source should be visible before decorative polish
design_positioning.density_posture: dense but readable product-tool layout for repeated use
design_positioning.interaction_posture: direct controls with clear hover, focus, disabled, loading and error feedback
design_positioning.anti_generic_position: reject generic AI-dashboard, marketing hero and decorative card compositions when the surface is operational

palette_policy.dark_light_policy: declare whether the product ships light, dark or both; do not improvise per screen

color_roles.avoid: using brand accent as full background

color_roles.usage: tool panels, inspectors and grouped controls
primary action and active state only
color_roles.avoid: painting every control with the accent

color_roles.usage: destructive action, failure and risk states
color_roles.avoid: using danger color for neutral warnings

typography_roles.usage: compact screen title that names the surface
typography_roles.constraints: no hero-scale type inside product tools

typography_roles.usage: small section labels and panel headings
typography_roles.constraints: must not wrap awkwardly in compact panels

typography_roles.usage: primary readable content, rows and descriptions
typography_roles.constraints: line height must preserve scan speed

typography_roles.usage: ids, timestamps, balances, counts and evidence refs
typography_roles.constraints: use tabular or monospace treatment only where it improves comparison

layout_contract.grid: app-shell with command area, primary work region and contextual inspector when density requires it
responsive_rules: mobile keeps the primary task first and moves inspector/detail below it
desktop may use multi-column layout only when columns stay readable
density_rules: operational surfaces should prefer compact rows, controls and inspectors
marketing-scale sections are forbidden unless the card is explicitly a public landing page
stable_dimensions: toolbars, icon buttons, counters and board/grid cells need stable dimensions
dynamic status text must wrap or truncate without resizing core controls
forbidden_layouts: decorative KPI blocks disconnected from product objects
split hero text/media layout for app tools

component_contracts.purpose: Expose primary commands, filters and mode switches close to the work surface.
interaction_rules: icons should be used for familiar tool actions with tooltip labels
accessibility_notes: controls require names and visible focus

component_contracts.purpose: Show object state, source, freshness and next action in one scannable row.
interaction_rules: row focus should reveal detail without losing list context
implementation_notes: long labels must not shift action controls

component_contracts.purpose: Show proof, gaps and review state for the selected object.
interaction_rules: evidence refs must be copyable or inspectable when safe
accessibility_notes: headings and regions must support keyboard navigation
implementation_notes: private evidence unavailable must be a real state, not an error-looking crash

feedback_rules: state changes must be visible in text and structure, not only color
dangerous or irreversible actions must show consequence before execution
empty_loading_error_rules: empty state names what is missing and the next safe action
error state preserves orientation and offers a bounded recovery path
risk_or_destructive_action_rules: risk actions need explicit label, consequence, disabled state and review path

forbidden_shortcuts: inventing one-off colors outside the token contract
using screenshots or private captures as committed design source
treating component library defaults as product design approval

do_rules: translate references into original tokens and components
explain why density, state and layout match the product job
keep product controls close to the data or state they affect
dont_rules: copy protected layouts, assets or product-specific text
ship generic dashboard polish as Product Face quality
hide blockers, stale data or missing evidence behind positive styling
review_checklist: tokens are named and mapped to implementation
components include required states and accessibility notes
layout rules cover mobile and desktop
Product Face proof can compare screenshots against this contract

screenshot_and_state_requirements: screenshots must show states named by this contract
review must compare visible tokens/components/layout against this contract

design_md_export.audience: AI coding agents, frontend implementers and Product Face reviewers

human_gate.reason: A human gate is required only when the design system changes the product promise, brand direction or risk messaging.
